title: Chris Singleton (basketball, born 1989)
wikitext:
'''Chris Singleton''' is the starting forward for the [[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State Seminoles basketball team]]. He is listed at 6'9" and currently 225 pounds. He is currently a junior at FSU. He is expected to be a first round draft pick in the [[2011 NBA Draft]]. In 2010 he was named the ACC Defensive Player of the Year. Singleton is from [[Canton, Georgia]] and played high school basketball at [[Dunwoody High School|Dunwoody High]].
